steps.label: 51a
steps.title: Fit drive jaw
instructions: Align the drive jaw with the actuator output and seat it.
Hold the drive jaw in place; secure both faces in the next two steps.

steps.title: Secure drive jaw — upper
instructions: Insert the four M2 × 8 screws on the upper face of the drive jaw.
Check that all four shown fasteners are seated.

steps.title: Secure drive jaw — lower
instructions: Insert the four M2 × 8 screws on the lower face of the drive jaw.
Check that all four shown fasteners are seated.

steps.label: 51b
steps.title: Fit opposing jaw
instructions: Align the opposing jaw pivot and mating gear teeth, then seat the jaw.
Hold the opposing jaw in place while fitting and securing its pivot caps in the following steps.

steps.label: 52a
steps.title: Fit upper jaw cap
instructions: Seat the cap in the upper jaw pivot.
Hold the cap in place; secure it with the retaining screw in the next step.

steps.title: Secure upper jaw cap
instructions: Hold the upper jaw cap in place and insert its M2.6 × 6 retaining screw.
Check that the retaining screw is seated and the cap is secured.

steps.label: 52b
steps.title: Fit lower jaw cap
instructions: Seat the cap in the lower jaw pivot.
Hold the cap in place; secure it with the retaining screw in the next step.

steps.title: Secure lower jaw cap
instructions: Hold the lower jaw cap in place and insert its M2.6 × 6 retaining screw.
Check that the retaining screw is seated and the cap is secured.

steps.title: Fit revised DC converter
instructions: Locate the next working area.
Fit the revised power board beneath the upper link.
Mechanical mounting only. Revised wiring is a separate check.

steps.title: Secure revised DC converter
instructions: Move to the next working face.
Insert the underside screws.
Check that all shown fasteners are seated.

steps.label: camera-prep-v013
steps.title: Prepare camera bracket
instructions: Prepare the camera bracket separately from the robot.
Keep the camera mounting holes accessible for the next steps.
steps.motionSource: Authored web camera subassembly v013; sourceFrames retained only as original film reference

steps.title: Fit camera to bracket
instructions: Align the camera with the four bracket mounting points, then seat it.
Support the camera on the bracket while fitting the four screws next.
steps.motionSource: Authored web camera subassembly v013; sourceFrames retained only as original film reference

steps.title: Secure camera to bracket
instructions: Insert all four M2 × 6 camera screws while the bracket is off the robot.
Check that the camera is secured before installing the complete module.
steps.motionSource: Authored web camera subassembly v013; sourceFrames retained only as original film reference

steps.title: Install camera assembly
instructions: Align the bracket locating hole with the rear peg, then slide the complete module along the peg axis.
Check that the locating peg is engaged and the bracket sits against its mounting face.
steps.motionSource: Authored web camera subassembly v013; sourceFrames retained only as original film reference

steps.title: Secure camera bracket
instructions: Support the seated camera assembly and insert the three M2 × 6 bracket screws.
Check that the bracket is secured against its mounting face.
steps.motionSource: Authored web camera subassembly v013; sourceFrames retained only as original film reference
